users._description: User profile. Subcollections: fcm_tokens (device tokens) and notification_settings (preferences doc 'preferences'). Only self or admin can read/write.

users/{uid}/fcm_tokens/{tokenId}._description: Per-device FCM tokens for push notifications.

users/{uid}/notification_settings/prefer._description: Per-user notification preferences (replaces legacy notifPrefs flat collection). Created automatically on user signup.

hardware_system._description: Single source of truth for hardware assignment. Written by admin; readable by any signed-in user (ESP32 reads anonymous if needed via separate mechanism).

currentOwner._description: Assigned owner doc. Contains uid + tank_id.

tanks._id: tank_id (== owner's uid by default, but may diverge later)
tanks._description: One tank per user. Contains subcollections for sensors, actuators, feeder, schedules, pending commands, and actuator logs.

sensor_readings/latest._description: Latest sensor reading per tank. Written exclusively by Cloud Functions (ESP32 writes to sensorIngestion; CF routes here using hardware_system/currentOwner.uid at write time). Readable by owner or admin.

sensors/{sensorName}._description: Per-sensor threshold/min-max config. Seeding done by _createTankIfMissing(). Readable/writable by tank owner.

actuators/{deviceId}._description: Pump and aerator control state. Written by Flutter (database_service.saveDeviceMode); ESP32 reads anonymous.

feeder/status._description: Current feeder status. ESP32 writes anonymous; readable by owner/admin.

feeder_schedules/{scheduleId}._description: Scheduled feeding times. Flutter reads/writes; ESP32 polls anonymous.

pending_commands/{commandId}._description: Manual / automatic feed commands pending ESP32 execution. Flutter creates; ESP32 reads and deletes processed commands (anonymous).

actuator_logs/{logId}._description: Flutter-only device activity log (no ESP32 involvement). Readable by owner/admin.

notifications/{notifId}._description: Root notification collection. Scoped by uid field (not doc ID). Readable if uid matches auth.user or readBy[auth.uid] == true.
fields: message (string) — note: diagram uses 'body'; code uses 'message'

batches._description: Flat collection for crayfish batches. Scoped by tankId field.

sampling_records._description: Flat collection for water-quality sampling records. Scoped by tankId.

mortality_records._description: Flat collection for mortality records. Scoped by tankId.

harvest_records._description: Flat collection for harvest records. Scoped by tankId.

sensorThresholds._description: Legacy flat collection mirroring tanks/{tankId}/sensors. Also mirrored to sensorThresholds/default for ESP32 firmware polling.

system_config._description: Admin-managed global settings. Any signed-in user can read (dashboard needs it).

notifPrefs._description: LEGACY — replaced by users/{uid}/notification_settings/preferences. Kept for backward compatibility.

notifMarkers._description: LEGACY — tracks last-seen notification markers, scoped by uid field.

sensorConfig._description: ESP32 uploads its current calibration values on boot (anonymous write; admin-only read).

sensorIngestion._description: Anonymous ESP32 ingestion endpoint (fixed path — no hardwareId since only one device exists). Cloud Functions read this and route/copy to sensorReadings/{ownerUid} using hardware_system/currentOwner.uid at write time.

current._description: Latest anonymous ingestion doc from ESP32 (~60s interval). Admin-only read/delete.

history._description: Anonymous append-only history (~60s interval). Admin-only read. Never edited/deleted by ESP32.

sensorReadings._id: ownerUid (doc ID IS owner — enforced by path)
sensorReadings._description: LEGACY / ALTERNATIVE flat collection for latest readings (written exclusively by Cloud Functions; never by ESP32 directly). Readable only by that owner or admin.

sensorReadingsHistory._description: Legacy historical readings with date subcollections.

docs._description: Cloud-Function-written historical readings. Reassigning hardware creates NEW history under new owner — previous owner's history is preserved permanently.

feederSchedules._description: LEGACY flat collection (replaced by tanks/{tankId}/feeder_schedules). Device owner reads/writes; ESP32 polls anonymous.

feederLogs._description: ESP32 + Flutter both create. Only device owner/admin can read/update/delete.

feederCommands._description: LEGACY flat command collection (replaced by tanks/{tankId}/pending_commands). Device owner creates; ESP32 reads & deletes processed commands (anonymous).

feederStatus._description: LEGACY flat status (replaced by tanks/{tankId}/feeder/status). ESP32 writes anonymous; only owner/admin reads.

feederDispatched._description: Flutter-only. Tracks which feeding schedules already fired today.

deviceModes._description: Device owner (Flutter) writes control modes. ESP32 reads anonymous.

deviceLogs._description: Flutter-only activity log. No ESP32 involvement.

mlPredictions._description: ML prediction results. Any signed-in user can read. Created/updated by Cloud Functions / ML pipeline.

healthRisk._description: Water-quality / health-risk prediction result per user.
